f-rtl.2.evidence:
Arabic topic by Omar renders mirrored: author/avatar and vote column on the right, reply cards start at the right, quote border is on the right (border-right 3px, left 0), list bullets sit at the right (padding-inline-start 24px, outside markers). FAIL: the code block does not stay left-to-right. Posted a fixture reply with 
const a = 1;\nfoo(a);
: computed direction rtl, unicode-bidi isolate, text-align left, and the code renders as ';const a = 1' / ';foo(a)' (trailing semicolons jump to the start). No direction:ltr rule exists for .jt-post-body pre / .jt-reply-body pre in jetonomy-rtl.css. Product bug. Screenshot rtl-list-code.png. Fixture reply deleted.

Breadcrumb separator is a plain '/' text (not a chevron) and Home is rightmost, correct reading order. Search glass (nav and header) transform none, no checkmarks or brand logos mirrored; numbers unmirrored. Back/prev arrows: none exist on the surfaces reachable here (space pagination is a 'Load More' button).
